summary: Procedure to configure compression in an AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup CR (global `use_db_compression: true`, per-component override), apply it with `oc apply`, watch it with `oc get ansibleautomationplatformbackup -w` and check for a Successful condition.
questions: How do I configure backup compression for the AAP operator?
How do I check an AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup completed?
Disable compression for controller backup only

answer_card.title: Configure compressed operator backups
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup
metadata:
  name: aap-backup
  namespace: aap
spec:
  deployment_name: aap
  use_db_compression: true        # global default
  controller:
    use_db_compression: false     # per-component override
```
```bash
oc apply -f backup.yml
oc get ansibleautomationplatformbackup -n aap -w
oc get ansibleautomationplatformbackup aap-backup -n aap -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'  # expect Successful
```
